items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: I had a fellow playing at this band, under the name of Aston Murray.

ctx.x: Did that band play mostly over here and there? All over. Well, he played on the other side, too, huh? Yeah, we played on the other side.

Well, we were just organized at that time, you see. Well, to get back to George August there, that's how did he get to his band. So I hired him out playing at the Midway in Harvard, you see. And I hired him to play with us. And he liked the way I played. And he said, man, you're the kind of man I need. I had a fellow playing at this band, under the name of Aston Murray. But he was mostly of lead, you know. He plays lead and didn't give him no support. And so he was a man like supporting the band, you know. And he…
Hmm, that's something, Coast to Coast. Yeah, Coast to Coast, yeah. I don't know, I lost those records.
